description: Committee recommends five-year tax abatement for Sandvik's $60 million facility.
Sandvik's development will create 17 new full-time jobs.
Total abatement estimated at $236,000 over five years.

chips.text: Taxpayers will fund an estimated $236,000 abatement.
SREDA spoke in support of the tax abatement application.

description: Renews SHA license for 5 years at Saskatoon Field House.
Includes 2.7% fee increase for the first year.
SHA pays $5,700 annually for specialized fitness equipment.

chips.text: Councillor Dubois clarified rental fees and city cost recovery.
Taxpayers support Field House rentals through millrate.

description: City will audit street sweeping program for efficiency and value.

chips.text: Chair confirmed audit is a 'value for money' assessment.
City is studying options to recycle or reuse street sweeping materials.

description: Extend Sutherland Memorial Hall lease to POW City Kinsmen Club.
Five-year term, with option for additional five years.
Club responsible for all costs, including major repairs.

chips.text: Hall rental rates are community-based, with a two-day wedding costing $1,500.
Community members benefit from affordable hall rental rates.

description: City would lease 1,748 sq ft at Field House to U of S.
U of S would create a no-cost rehabilitation clinic.
U of S would fund $749,000 renovations; City waives 10 years rent.

chips.text: Melissa Koenig spoke for U of S, supporting a student-led, no-cost clinic.
Clinic would provide no-cost care for residents unable to afford ongoing therapy.

description: Finance Committee held a private meeting.
